lines: [quiet, very controlled] Dad. [pause] Who is she?
[steady, almost a whisper] I opened the bakery at four this morning. He texted me to ask where we keep the keys.
[bright, smiling] Perfect. The cake's here. Could you show her to the kitchen?
[soft, as if asking a favor] Dad gets one night.
[small, tired] I was going to tell you after breakfast tomorrow.
[fond, polished] I dropped Dad's birthday cake when I was twelve.
[in her own plain voice] That's what they paid me to say. My name is Megan.
[dry] He asked which one you wear on camera. I told him you wear the same one until I physically take it off you.
[friendly, getting right to it] I thought I saw you come in. Can we talk about tomorrow?
